envVars.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
envVars.purpose: API key sent as `X-Api-Key` header. When set, this key is used instead of your Claude Pro, Max, Team, or Enterprise subscription even if you are logged in. In non-interactive mode (`-p`), the key is always used when present. In interactive mode, you are prompted to approve the key once before it overrides your subscription. To use your subscription instead, run `unset ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`

envVars.name: ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN
envVars.purpose: Custom value for the `Authorization` header (the value you set here will be prefixed with `Bearer `)

envVars.name: ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL
envVars.purpose: Override the API endpoint to route requests through a proxy or gateway. When set to a non-first-party host, [MCP tool search](/en/mcp#scale-with-mcp-tool-search) is disabled by default. Set `ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH=true` if your proxy forwards `tool_reference` blocks

envVars.name: ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_BASE_URL
envVars.purpose: Override the Bedrock endpoint URL. Use for custom Bedrock endpoints or when routing through an [LLM gateway](/en/llm-gateway). See [Amazon Bedrock](/en/amazon-bedrock)

envVars.name: ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_MANTLE_BASE_URL
envVars.purpose: Override the Bedrock Mantle endpoint URL. See [Mantle endpoint](/en/amazon-bedrock#use-the-mantle-endpoint)

envVars.name: ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_SERVICE_TIER
envVars.purpose: Bedrock [service tier](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/service-tiers-inference.html) (`default`, `flex`, or `priority`). Sent as the `X-Amzn-Bedrock-Service-Tier` header. See [Amazon Bedrock](/en/amazon-bedrock#service-tiers)

envVars.name: ANTHROPIC_BETAS
envVars.purpose: Comma-separated list of additional `anthropic-beta` header values to include in API requests. Claude Code already sends the beta headers it needs; use this to opt into an [Anthropic API beta](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta-headers) before Claude Code adds native support. Unlike the [`--betas` flag](/en/cli-reference#cli-flags), which requires API key authentication, this variable works with all auth methods including Claude.ai subscription

envVars.name: ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS
envVars.purpose: Custom headers to add to requests (`Name: Value` format, newline-separated for multiple headers)

envVars.name: ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_MODEL_OPTION
envVars.purpose: Model ID to add as a custom entry in the `/model` picker. Use this to make a non-standard or gateway-specific model selectable without replacing built-in aliases. See [Model configuration](/en/model-config#add-a-custom-model-option)

envVars.name: ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_MODEL_OPTION_DESCRIPTION
envVars.purpose: Display description for the custom model entry in the `/model` picker. Defaults to `Custom model (<model-id>)` when not set

envVars.name: ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_MODEL_OPTION_NAME
envVars.purpose: Display name for the custom model entry in the `/model` picker. Defaults to the model ID when not set

envVars.name: ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_MODEL_OPTION_SUPPORTED_CAPABILITIES
envVars.purpose: See [Model configuration](/en/model-config#customize-pinned-model-display-and-capabilities)

envVars.name: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL
envVars.purpose: See [Model configuration](/en/model-config#environment-variables)

envVars.name: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL_DESCRIPTION
envVars.purpose: See [Model configuration](/en/model-config#customize-pinned-model-display-and-capabilities)

envVars.name: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL_NAME
envVars.purpose: See [Model configuration](/en/model-config#customize-pinned-model-display-and-capabilities)

envVars.name: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL_SUPPORTED_CAPABILITIES
envVars.purpose: See [Model configuration](/en/model-config#customize-pinned-model-display-and-capabilities)

envVars.name: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL
envVars.purpose: See [Model configuration](/en/model-config#environment-variables)

envVars.name: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL_DESCRIPTION
envVars.purpose: See [Model configuration](/en/model-config#customize-pinned-model-display-and-capabilities)

envVars.name: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL_NAME
envVars.purpose: See [Model configuration](/en/model-config#customize-pinned-model-display-and-capabilities)

envVars.name: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL_SUPPORTED_CAPABILITIES
envVars.purpose: See [Model configuration](/en/model-config#customize-pinned-model-display-and-capabilities)

envVars.name: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL
envVars.purpose: See [Model configuration](/en/model-config#environment-variables)

envVars.name: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL_DESCRIPTION
envVars.purpose: See [Model configuration](/en/model-config#customize-pinned-model-display-and-capabilities)

envVars.name: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL_NAME
envVars.purpose: See [Model configuration](/en/model-config#customize-pinned-model-display-and-capabilities)

envVars.name: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL_SUPPORTED_CAPABILITIES
envVars.purpose: See [Model configuration](/en/model-config#customize-pinned-model-display-and-capabilities)

envVars.name: ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_API_KEY
envVars.purpose: API key for Microsoft Foundry authentication (see [Microsoft Foundry](/en/microsoft-foundry))

envVars.name: ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_BASE_URL
envVars.purpose: Full base URL for the Foundry resource (for example, `https://my-resource.services.ai.azure.com/anthropic`). Alternative to `ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_RESOURCE` (see [Microsoft Foundry](/en/microsoft-foundry))

envVars.name: ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_RESOURCE
envVars.purpose: Foundry resource name (for example, `my-resource`). Required if `ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_BASE_URL` is not set (see [Microsoft Foundry](/en/microsoft-foundry))

envVars.name: ANTHROPIC_MODEL
envVars.purpose: Name of the model setting to use (see [Model Configuration](/en/model-config#environment-variables))

envVars.name: ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL
envVars.purpose: \[DEPRECATED] Name of [Haiku-class model for background tasks](/en/costs)

envVars.name: ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL_AWS_REGION
envVars.purpose: Override AWS region for the Haiku-class model when using Bedrock or Bedrock Mantle

envVars.name: ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_BASE_URL
envVars.purpose: Override the Vertex AI endpoint URL. Use for custom Vertex endpoints or when routing through an [LLM gateway](/en/llm-gateway). See [Google Vertex AI](/en/google-vertex-ai)

envVars.name: ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_PROJECT_ID
envVars.purpose: GCP project ID for Vertex AI. Required when using [Google Vertex AI](/en/google-vertex-ai)

envVars.name: API_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.purpose: Timeout for API requests in milliseconds (default: 600000, or 10 minutes; maximum: 2147483647). Increase this when requests time out on slow networks or when routing through a proxy. Values above the maximum overflow the underlying timer and cause requests to fail immediately

envVars.name: AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK
envVars.purpose: Bedrock API key for authentication (see [Bedrock API keys](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/machine-learning/accelerate-ai-development-with-amazon-bedrock-api-keys/))

envVars.name: BASH_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.purpose: Default timeout for long-running bash commands (default: 120000, or 2 minutes)

envVars.name: BASH_MAX_OUTPUT_LENGTH
envVars.purpose: Maximum number of characters in bash outputs before they are middle-truncated

envVars.name: BASH_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.purpose: Maximum timeout the model can set for long-running bash commands (default: 600000, or 10 minutes)

envVars.name: CCR_FORCE_BUNDLE
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to force [`claude --remote`](/en/claude-code-on-the-web#send-local-repositories-without-github) to bundle and upload your local repository even when GitHub access is available

envVars.name: CLAUDE_AGENT_SDK_DISABLE_BUILTIN_AGENTS
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to disable all built-in [subagent](/en/sub-agents) types such as Explore and Plan. Only applies in non-interactive mode (the `-p` flag). Useful for SDK users who want a blank slate

envVars.name: CLAUDE_AGENT_SDK_MCP_NO_PREFIX
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to skip the `mcp__<server>__` prefix on tool names from SDK-created MCP servers. Tools use their original names. SDK usage only

envVars.name: CLAUDE_AUTO_BACKGROUND_TASKS
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to force-enable automatic backgrounding of long-running agent tasks. When enabled, subagents are moved to the background after running for approximately two minutes

envVars.name: CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE
envVars.purpose: Set the percentage of context capacity (1-100) at which auto-compaction triggers. By default, auto-compaction triggers at approximately 95% capacity. Use lower values like `50` to compact earlier. Values above the default threshold have no effect. Applies to both main conversations and subagents. This percentage aligns with the `context_window.used_percentage` field available in [status line](/en/statusline)

envVars.name: CLAUDE_BASH_MAINTAIN_PROJECT_WORKING_DIR
envVars.purpose: Return to the original working directory after each Bash or PowerShell command in the main session

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_ACCESSIBILITY
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to keep the native terminal cursor visible and disable the inverted-text cursor indicator. Allows screen magnifiers like macOS Zoom to track cursor position

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_ADDITIONAL_DIRECTORIES_CLAUDE_MD
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to load memory files from directories specified with `--add-dir`. Loads `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/rules/*.md`, and `CLAUDE.local.md`. By default, additional directories do not load memory files

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_API_KEY_HELPER_TTL_MS
envVars.purpose: Interval in milliseconds at which credentials should be refreshed (when using [`apiKeyHelper`](/en/settings#available-settings))

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER
envVars.purpose: Set to `0` to omit the attribution block (client version and prompt fingerprint) from the start of the system prompt. Disabling it improves prompt-cache hit rates when routing through an [LLM gateway](/en/llm-gateway). Anthropic API caching is unaffected

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW
envVars.purpose: Set the context capacity in tokens used for auto-compaction calculations. Defaults to the model's context window: 200K for standard models or 1M for [extended context](/en/model-config#extended-context) models. Use a lower value like `500000` on a 1M model to treat the window as 500K for compaction purposes. The value is capped at the model's actual context window. `CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE` is applied as a percentage of this value. Setting this variable decouples the compaction threshold from the status line's `used_percentage`, which always uses the model's full context window

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_CONNECT_IDE
envVars.purpose: Override automatic [IDE connection](/en/vs-code). By default, Claude Code connects automatically when launched inside a supported IDE's integrated terminal. Set to `false` to prevent this. Set to `true` to force a connection attempt when auto-detection fails, such as when tmux obscures the parent terminal

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_CERT_STORE
envVars.purpose: Comma-separated list of CA certificate sources for TLS connections. `bundled` is the Mozilla CA set shipped with Claude Code. `system` is the operating system trust store. Default is `bundled,system`. The native binary distribution is required for system store integration. On the Node.js runtime, only the bundled set is used regardless of this value

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_CLIENT_CERT
envVars.purpose: Path to client certificate file for mTLS authentication

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_CLIENT_KEY
envVars.purpose: Path to client private key file for mTLS authentication

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_CLIENT_KEY_PASSPHRASE
envVars.purpose: Passphrase for encrypted CLAUDE\_CODE\_CLIENT\_KEY (optional)

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DEBUG_LOG_LEVEL
envVars.purpose: Minimum log level written to the debug log file. Values: `verbose`, `debug` (default), `info`, `warn`, `error`. Set to `verbose` to include high-volume diagnostics like full status line command output, or raise to `error` to reduce noise

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DEBUG_LOGS_DIR
envVars.purpose: Override the debug log file path. Despite the name, this is a file path, not a directory. Requires debug mode to be enabled separately via `--debug` or `/debug`: setting this variable alone does not enable logging. The [`--debug-file`](/en/cli-reference#cli-flags) flag does both at once. Defaults to `~/.claude/debug/<session-id>.txt`

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to disable [1M context window](/en/model-config#extended-context) support. When set, 1M model variants are unavailable in the model picker. Useful for enterprise environments with compliance requirements

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ADAPTIVE_THINKING
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to disable [adaptive reasoning](/en/model-config#adjust-effort-level) on Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 and fall back to the fixed thinking budget controlled by `MAX_THINKING_TOKENS`. {/* min-version: 2.1.111 */}Has no effect on Opus 4.7, which always uses adaptive reasoning

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ATTACHMENTS
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to disable attachment processing. File mentions with `@` syntax are sent as plain text instead of being expanded into file content

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to disable [auto memory](/en/memory#auto-memory). Set to `0` to force auto memory on during the gradual rollout. When disabled, Claude does not create or load auto memory files

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BACKGROUND_TASKS
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to disable all background task functionality, including the `run_in_background` parameter on Bash and subagent tools, auto-backgrounding, and the Ctrl+B shortcut

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CLAUDE_MDS
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to prevent loading any CLAUDE.md memory files into context, including user, project, and auto-memory files

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CRON
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to disable [scheduled tasks](/en/scheduled-tasks). The `/loop` skill and cron tools become unavailable and any already-scheduled tasks stop firing, including tasks that are already running mid-session

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to strip Anthropic-specific `anthropic-beta` request headers and beta tool-schema fields (such as `defer_loading` and `eager_input_streaming`) from API requests. Use this when a proxy gateway rejects requests with errors like "Unexpected value(s) for the `anthropic-beta` header" or "Extra inputs are not permitted". Standard fields (`name`, `description`, `input_schema`, `cache_control`) are preserved.

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FAST_MODE
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to disable [fast mode](/en/fast-mode)

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FEEDBACK_SURVEY
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to disable the "How is Claude doing?" session quality surveys. Surveys are also disabled when `DISABLE_TELEMETRY` or `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC` is set. See [Session quality surveys](/en/data-usage#session-quality-surveys)

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FILE_CHECKPOINTING
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to disable file [checkpointing](/en/checkpointing). The `/rewind` command will not be able to restore code changes

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_GIT_INSTRUCTIONS
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to remove built-in commit and PR workflow instructions and the git status snapshot from Claude's system prompt. Useful when using your own git workflow skills. Takes precedence over the [`includeGitInstructions`](/en/settings#available-settings) setting when set

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_LEGACY_MODEL_REMAP
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to prevent automatic remapping of Opus 4.0 and 4.1 to the current Opus version on the Anthropic API. Use when you intentionally want to pin an older model. The remap does not run on Bedrock, Vertex, or Foundry

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MOUSE
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to disable mouse tracking in [fullscreen rendering](/en/fullscreen). Keyboard scrolling with `PgUp` and `PgDn` still works. Use this to keep your terminal's native copy-on-select behavior

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC
envVars.purpose: Equivalent of setting `DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER`, `DISABLE_FEEDBACK_COMMAND`, `DISABLE_ERROR_REPORTING`, and `DISABLE_TELEMETRY`

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONSTREAMING_FALLBACK
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to disable the non-streaming fallback when a streaming request fails mid-stream. Streaming errors propagate to the retry layer instead. Useful when a proxy or gateway causes the fallback to produce duplicate tool execution

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_OFFICIAL_MARKETPLACE_AUTOINSTALL
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to skip automatic addition of the official plugin marketplace on first run

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_POLICY_SKILLS
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to skip loading skills from the system-wide managed skills directory. Useful for container or CI sessions that should not load operator-provisioned skills

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_TERMINAL_TITLE
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to disable automatic terminal title updates based on conversation context

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_THINKING
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to force-disable [extended thinking](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/extended-thinking) regardless of model support or other settings. More direct than `MAX_THINKING_TOKENS=0`

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_VIRTUAL_SCROLL
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to disable virtual scrolling in [fullscreen rendering](/en/fullscreen) and render every message in the transcript. Use this if scrolling in fullscreen mode shows blank regions where messages should appear

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL
envVars.purpose: Set the effort level for supported models. Values: `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, `max`, or `auto` to use the model default. Available levels depend on the model. Takes precedence over `/effort` and the `effortLevel` setting. See [Adjust effort level](/en/model-config#adjust-effort-level)

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AWAY_SUMMARY
envVars.purpose: Override [session recap](/en/interactive-mode#session-recap) availability. Set to `0` to force recaps off regardless of the `/config` toggle. Set to `1` to force recaps on when [`awaySummaryEnabled`](/en/settings#available-settings) is `false`. Takes precedence over the setting and `/config` toggle

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_BACKGROUND_PLUGIN_REFRESH
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to refresh plugin state at turn boundaries in [non-interactive mode](/en/headless) after a background install completes. Off by default because the refresh changes the system prompt mid-session, which invalidates [prompt caching](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-caching) for that turn

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FINE_GRAINED_TOOL_STREAMING
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to force-enable fine-grained tool input streaming. Without this, the API buffers tool input parameters fully before sending delta events, which can delay display on large tool inputs. Anthropic API only: has no effect on Bedrock, Vertex, or Foundry

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_PROMPT_SUGGESTION
envVars.purpose: Set to `false` to disable prompt suggestions (the "Prompt suggestions" toggle in `/config`). These are the grayed-out predictions that appear in your prompt input after Claude responds. See [Prompt suggestions](/en/interactive-mode#prompt-suggestions)

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TASKS
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to enable the task tracking system in non-interactive mode (the `-p` flag). Tasks are on by default in interactive mode. See [Task list](/en/interactive-mode#task-list)

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TELEMETRY
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to enable OpenTelemetry data collection for metrics and logging. Required before configuring OTel exporters. See [Monitoring](/en/monitoring-usage)

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_EXIT_AFTER_STOP_DELAY
envVars.purpose: Time in milliseconds to wait after the query loop becomes idle before automatically exiting. Useful for automated workflows and scripts using SDK mode

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to enable [agent teams](/en/agent-teams). Agent teams are experimental and disabled by default

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_EXTRA_BODY
envVars.purpose: JSON object to merge into the top level of every API request body. Useful for passing provider-specific parameters that Claude Code does not expose directly

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_FILE_READ_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS
envVars.purpose: Override the default token limit for file reads. Useful when you need to read larger files in full

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to enable [forked subagents](/en/sub-agents#fork-the-current-conversation). A forked subagent inherits the full conversation context from the main session instead of starting fresh. When enabled, `/fork` spawns a forked subagent rather than acting as an alias for [`/branch`](/en/commands), and all subagent spawns run in the background. Works in interactive mode and via the SDK or `claude -p`

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_GIT_BASH_PATH
envVars.purpose: Windows only: path to the Git Bash executable (`bash.exe`). Use when Git Bash is installed but not in your PATH. See [Windows setup](/en/setup#set-up-on-windows)

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_GLOB_HIDDEN
envVars.purpose: Set to `false` to exclude dotfiles from results when Claude invokes the [Glob tool](/en/tools-reference). Included by default. Does not affect `@` file autocomplete, `ls`, Grep, or Read

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_GLOB_NO_IGNORE
envVars.purpose: Set to `false` to make the [Glob tool](/en/tools-reference) respect `.gitignore` patterns. By default, Glob returns all matching files including gitignored ones. Does not affect `@` file autocomplete, which has its own [`respectGitignore` setting](/en/settings#available-settings)

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_GLOB_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
envVars.purpose: Timeout in seconds for Glob tool file discovery. Defaults to 20 seconds on most platforms and 60 seconds on WSL

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_HIDE_CWD
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to hide the working directory in the startup logo. Useful for screenshares or recordings where the path exposes your OS username

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_IDE_HOST_OVERRIDE
envVars.purpose: Override the host address used to connect to the IDE extension. By default Claude Code auto-detects the correct address, including WSL-to-Windows routing

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_IDE_SKIP_AUTO_INSTALL
envVars.purpose: Skip auto-installation of IDE extensions. Equivalent to setting [`autoInstallIdeExtension`](/en/settings#global-config-settings) to `false`

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_IDE_SKIP_VALID_CHECK
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to skip validation of IDE lockfile entries during connection. Use when auto-connect fails to find your IDE despite it running

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS
envVars.purpose: Override the context window size Claude Code assumes for the active model. Only takes effect when `DISABLE_COMPACT` is also set. Use this when routing to a model through `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` whose context window does not match the built-in size for its name

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS
envVars.purpose: Set the maximum number of output tokens for most requests. Defaults and caps vary by model; see [max output tokens](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview#latest-models-comparison). Increasing this value reduces the effective context window available before [auto-compaction](/en/costs#reduce-token-usage) triggers.

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_RETRIES
envVars.purpose: Override the number of times to retry failed API requests (default: 10)

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_TOOL_USE_CONCURRENCY
envVars.purpose: Maximum number of read-only tools and subagents that can execute in parallel (default: 10). Higher values increase parallelism but consume more resources

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_ALLOWLIST_ENV
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to spawn stdio MCP servers with only a safe baseline environment plus the server's configured `env`, instead of inheriting your shell environment

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_NEW_INIT
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to make `/init` run an interactive setup flow. The flow asks which files to generate, including CLAUDE.md, skills, and hooks, before exploring the codebase and writing them. Without this variable, `/init` generates a CLAUDE.md automatically without prompting.

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_NO_FLICKER
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to enable [fullscreen rendering](/en/fullscreen), a research preview that reduces flicker and keeps memory flat in long conversations. Equivalent to the [`tui`](/en/settings#available-settings) setting; you can also switch with `/tui fullscreen`

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_REFRESH_TOKEN
envVars.purpose: OAuth refresh token for Claude.ai authentication. When set, `claude auth login` exchanges this token directly instead of opening a browser. Requires `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_SCOPES`. Useful for provisioning authentication in automated environments

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_SCOPES
envVars.purpose: Space-separated OAuth scopes the refresh token was issued with, such as `"user:profile user:inference user:sessions:claude_code"`. Required when `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_REFRESH_TOKEN` is set

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN
envVars.purpose: OAuth access token for Claude.ai authentication. Alternative to `/login` for SDK and automated environments. Takes precedence over keychain-stored credentials. Generate one with [`claude setup-token`](/en/authentication#generate-a-long-lived-token)

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_OTEL_FLUSH_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.purpose: Timeout in milliseconds for flushing pending OpenTelemetry spans (default: 5000). See [Monitoring](/en/monitoring-usage)

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_OTEL_HEADERS_HELPER_DEBOUNCE_MS
envVars.purpose: Interval for refreshing dynamic OpenTelemetry headers in milliseconds (default: 1740000 / 29 minutes). See [Dynamic headers](/en/monitoring-usage#dynamic-headers)

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_OTEL_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.purpose: Timeout in milliseconds for the OpenTelemetry exporter to finish on shutdown (default: 2000). Increase if metrics are dropped at exit. See [Monitoring](/en/monitoring-usage)

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_PERFORCE_MODE
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to enable Perforce-aware write protection. When set, Edit, Write, and NotebookEdit fail with a `p4 edit <file>` hint if the target file lacks the owner-write bit, which Perforce clears on synced files until `p4 edit` opens them. This prevents Claude Code from bypassing Perforce change tracking

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_CACHE_DIR
envVars.purpose: Override the plugins root directory. Despite the name, this sets the parent directory, not the cache itself: marketplaces and the plugin cache live in subdirectories under this path. Defaults to `~/.claude/plugins`

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_GIT_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.purpose: Timeout in milliseconds for git operations when installing or updating plugins (default: 120000). Increase this value for large repositories or slow network connections. See [Git operations time out](/en/plugin-marketplaces#git-operations-time-out)

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_KEEP_MARKETPLACE_ON_FAILURE
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to keep the existing marketplace cache when a `git pull` fails instead of wiping and re-cloning. Useful in offline or airgapped environments where re-cloning would fail the same way. See [Marketplace updates fail in offline environments](/en/plugin-marketplaces#marketplace-updates-fail-in-offline-environments)

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_SEED_DIR
envVars.purpose: Path to one or more read-only plugin seed directories, separated by `:` on Unix or `;` on Windows. Use this to bundle a pre-populated plugins directory into a container image. Claude Code registers marketplaces from these directories at startup and uses pre-cached plugins without re-cloning. See [Pre-populate plugins for containers](/en/plugin-marketplaces#pre-populate-plugins-for-containers)

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_PROXY_RESOLVES_HOSTS
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to allow the proxy to perform DNS resolution instead of the caller. Opt-in for environments where the proxy should handle hostname resolution

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE
envVars.purpose: Set automatically to `true` when Claude Code is running as a [cloud session](/en/claude-code-on-the-web). Read this from a hook or setup script to detect whether you are in a cloud environment

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE_SESSION_ID
envVars.purpose: Set automatically in [cloud sessions](/en/claude-code-on-the-web) to the current session's ID. Read this to construct a link back to the session transcript. See [Link artifacts back to the session](/en/claude-code-on-the-web#link-artifacts-back-to-the-session)

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to automatically resume if the previous session ended mid-turn. Used in SDK mode so the model continues without requiring the SDK to re-send the prompt

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SCRIPT_CAPS
envVars.purpose: JSON object limiting how many times specific scripts may be invoked per session when `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB` is set. Keys are substrings matched against the command text; values are integer call limits. For example, `{"deploy.sh": 2}` allows `deploy.sh` to be called at most twice. Matching is substring-based so shell-expansion tricks like `./scripts/deploy.sh $(evil)` still count against the cap. Runtime fan-out via `xargs` or `find -exec` is not detected; this is a defense-in-depth control

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SCROLL_SPEED
envVars.purpose: Set the mouse wheel scroll multiplier in [fullscreen rendering](/en/fullscreen#mouse-wheel-scrolling). Accepts values from 1 to 20. Set to `3` to match `vim` if your terminal sends one wheel event per notch without amplification

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SESSIONEND_HOOKS_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.purpose: Override the time budget in milliseconds for [SessionEnd](/en/hooks#sessionend) hooks. Applies to session exit, `/clear`, and switching sessions via interactive `/resume`. By default the budget is 1.5 seconds, automatically raised to the highest per-hook `timeout` configured in settings files, up to 60 seconds. Timeouts on plugin-provided hooks do not raise the budget

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SHELL
envVars.purpose: Override automatic shell detection. Useful when your login shell differs from your preferred working shell (for example, `bash` vs `zsh`)

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SHELL_PREFIX
envVars.purpose: Command prefix to wrap all bash commands (for example, for logging or auditing). Example: `/path/to/logger.sh` will execute `/path/to/logger.sh <command>`

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to run with a minimal system prompt and only the Bash, file read, and file edit tools. MCP tools from `--mcp-config` are still available. Disables auto-discovery of hooks, skills, plugins, MCP servers, auto memory, and CLAUDE.md. The [`--bare`](/en/headless#start-faster-with-bare-mode) CLI flag sets this

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE_SYSTEM_PROMPT
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to use a shorter system prompt and abbreviated tool descriptions on Opus 4.7. Has no effect on other models. The full tool set, hooks, MCP servers, and CLAUDE.md discovery remain enabled

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_BEDROCK_AUTH
envVars.purpose: Skip AWS authentication for Bedrock (for example, when using an LLM gateway)

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_FOUNDRY_AUTH
envVars.purpose: Skip Azure authentication for Microsoft Foundry (for example, when using an LLM gateway)

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_MANTLE_AUTH
envVars.purpose: Skip AWS authentication for Bedrock Mantle (for example, when using an LLM gateway)

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_PROMPT_HISTORY
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to skip writing prompt history and session transcripts to disk. Sessions started with this variable set do not appear in `--resume`, `--continue`, or up-arrow history. Useful for ephemeral scripted sessions

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_VERTEX_AUTH
envVars.purpose: Skip Google authentication for Vertex (for example, when using an LLM gateway)

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL
envVars.purpose: See [Model configuration](/en/model-config)

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to strip Anthropic and cloud provider credentials from subprocess environments (Bash tool, hooks, MCP stdio servers). The parent Claude process keeps these credentials for API calls, but child processes cannot read them, reducing exposure to prompt injection attacks that attempt to exfiltrate secrets via shell expansion. On Linux, this also runs Bash subprocesses in an isolated PID namespace so they cannot read host process environments via `/proc`; as a side effect, `ps`, `pgrep`, and `kill` cannot see or signal host processes. `claude-code-action` sets this automatically when `allowed_non_write_users` is configured

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_PLUGIN_INSTALL
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` in non-interactive mode (the `-p` flag) to wait for plugin installation to complete before the first query. Without this, plugins install in the background and may not be available on the first turn. Combine with `CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_PLUGIN_INSTALL_TIMEOUT_MS` to bound the wait

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_PLUGIN_INSTALL_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.purpose: Timeout in milliseconds for synchronous plugin installation. When exceeded, Claude Code proceeds without plugins and logs an error. No default: without this variable, synchronous installation waits until complete

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SYNTAX_HIGHLIGHT
envVars.purpose: Set to `false` to disable syntax highlighting in diff output. Useful when colors interfere with your terminal setup

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_TASK_LIST_ID
envVars.purpose: Share a task list across sessions. Set the same ID in multiple Claude Code instances to coordinate on a shared task list. See [Task list](/en/interactive-mode#task-list)

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_TEAM_NAME
envVars.purpose: Name of the agent team this teammate belongs to. Set automatically on [agent team](/en/agent-teams) members

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR
envVars.purpose: Override the temp directory used for internal temp files. Claude Code appends `/claude-{uid}/` (Unix) or `/claude/` (Windows) to this path. Default: `/tmp` on macOS, `os.tmpdir()` on Linux/Windows

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_TMUX_TRUECOLOR
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to allow 24-bit truecolor output inside tmux. By default, Claude Code clamps to 256 colors when `$TMUX` is set because tmux does not pass through truecolor escape sequences unless configured to. Set this after adding `set -ga terminal-overrides ',*:Tc'` to your `~/.tmux.conf`. See [Terminal configuration](/en/terminal-config) for other tmux settings

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK
envVars.purpose: Use [Bedrock](/en/amazon-bedrock)

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_USE_FOUNDRY
envVars.purpose: Use [Microsoft Foundry](/en/microsoft-foundry)

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_USE_MANTLE
envVars.purpose: Use the Bedrock [Mantle endpoint](/en/amazon-bedrock#use-the-mantle-endpoint)

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_USE_NATIVE_FILE_SEARCH
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to discover custom commands, subagents, and output styles using Node.js file APIs instead of ripgrep. Set this if the bundled ripgrep binary is unavailable or blocked in your environment. Does not affect the Grep or file search tools

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_USE_POWERSHELL_TOOL
envVars.purpose: Controls the PowerShell tool. On Windows without Git Bash, the tool is enabled automatically; set to `0` to disable it. On Windows with Git Bash installed, the tool is rolling out progressively: set to `1` to opt in or `0` to opt out. On Linux, macOS, and WSL, set to `1` to enable it, which requires `pwsh` on your `PATH`. When enabled on Windows, Claude can run PowerShell commands natively instead of routing through Git Bash. See [PowerShell tool](/en/tools-reference#powershell-tool)

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX
envVars.purpose: Use [Vertex](/en/google-vertex-ai)

envVars.name: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR
envVars.purpose: Override the configuration directory (default: `~/.claude`). All settings, credentials, session history, and plugins are stored under this path. Useful for running multiple accounts side by side: for example, `alias claude-work='CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=~/.claude-work claude'`

envVars.name: CLAUDE_ENABLE_BYTE_WATCHDOG
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to force-enable the byte-level streaming idle watchdog, or set to `0` to force-disable it. When unset, the watchdog is enabled by default for Anthropic API connections. The byte watchdog aborts a connection when no bytes arrive on the wire for the duration set by `CLAUDE_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS`, with a minimum of 5 minutes, independent of the event-level watchdog

envVars.name: CLAUDE_ENABLE_STREAM_WATCHDOG
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to enable the event-level streaming idle watchdog. Off by default. For Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry, this is the only idle watchdog available. Configure the timeout with `CLAUDE_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS`

envVars.name: CLAUDE_ENV_FILE
envVars.purpose: Path to a shell script whose contents Claude Code runs before each Bash command in the same shell process, so exports in the file are visible to the command. Use to persist virtualenv or conda activation across commands. Also populated dynamically by [SessionStart](/en/hooks#persist-environment-variables), [Setup](/en/hooks#setup), [CwdChanged](/en/hooks#cwdchanged), and [FileChanged](/en/hooks#filechanged) hooks

envVars.name: CLAUDE_REMOTE_CONTROL_SESSION_NAME_PREFIX
envVars.purpose: Prefix for auto-generated [Remote Control](/en/remote-control) session names when no explicit name is provided. Defaults to your machine's hostname, producing names like `myhost-graceful-unicorn`. The `--remote-control-session-name-prefix` CLI flag sets the same value for a single invocation

envVars.name: CLAUDE_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.purpose: Timeout in milliseconds before the streaming idle watchdog closes a stalled connection. For the byte-level watchdog on the Anthropic API: default and minimum `300000` (5 minutes); lower values are silently clamped to absorb extended thinking pauses and proxy buffering. For the event-level watchdog: default `90000` (90 seconds), no minimum. For third-party providers, requires `CLAUDE_ENABLE_STREAM_WATCHDOG=1`

envVars.name: CLAUDECODE
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` in shell environments Claude Code spawns (Bash tool, tmux sessions). Not set in [hooks](/en/hooks) or [status line](/en/statusline) commands. Use to detect when a script is running inside a shell spawned by Claude Code

envVars.name: DISABLE_AUTO_COMPACT
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to disable automatic compaction when approaching the context limit. The manual `/compact` command remains available. Use when you want explicit control over when compaction occurs

envVars.name: DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to disable automatic background updates. Manual `claude update` still works. Use `DISABLE_UPDATES` to block both

envVars.name: DISABLE_COMPACT
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to disable all compaction: both automatic compaction and the manual `/compact` command

envVars.name: DISABLE_COST_WARNINGS
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to disable cost warning messages

envVars.name: DISABLE_DOCTOR_COMMAND
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to hide the `/doctor` command. Useful for managed deployments where users should not run installation diagnostics

envVars.name: DISABLE_ERROR_REPORTING
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to opt out of Sentry error reporting

envVars.name: DISABLE_EXTRA_USAGE_COMMAND
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to hide the `/extra-usage` command that lets users purchase additional usage beyond rate limits

envVars.name: DISABLE_FEEDBACK_COMMAND
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to disable the `/feedback` command. The older name `DISABLE_BUG_COMMAND` is also accepted

envVars.name: DISABLE_INSTALL_GITHUB_APP_COMMAND
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to hide the `/install-github-app` command. Already hidden when using third-party providers (Bedrock, Vertex, or Foundry)

envVars.name: DISABLE_INSTALLATION_CHECKS
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to disable installation warnings. Use only when manually managing the installation location, as this can mask issues with standard installations

envVars.name: DISABLE_INTERLEAVED_THINKING
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to prevent sending the interleaved-thinking beta header. Useful when your LLM gateway or provider does not support [interleaved thinking](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/extended-thinking#interleaved-thinking)

envVars.name: DISABLE_LOGIN_COMMAND
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to hide the `/login` command. Useful when authentication is handled externally via API keys or `apiKeyHelper`

envVars.name: DISABLE_LOGOUT_COMMAND
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to hide the `/logout` command

envVars.name: DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to disable prompt caching for all models (takes precedence over per-model settings)

envVars.name: DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_HAIKU
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to disable prompt caching for Haiku models

envVars.name: DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_OPUS
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to disable prompt caching for Opus models

envVars.name: DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_SONNET
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to disable prompt caching for Sonnet models

envVars.name: DISABLE_TELEMETRY
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to opt out of Statsig telemetry (note that Statsig events do not include user data like code, file paths, or bash commands)

envVars.name: DISABLE_UPDATES
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to block all updates including manual `claude update` and `claude install`. Stricter than `DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER`. Use when distributing Claude Code through your own channels and users should not self-update

envVars.name: DISABLE_UPGRADE_COMMAND
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to hide the `/upgrade` command

envVars.name: ENABLE_CLAUDEAI_MCP_SERVERS
envVars.purpose: Set to `false` to disable [claude.ai MCP servers](/en/mcp#use-mcp-servers-from-claude-ai) in Claude Code. Enabled by default for logged-in users

envVars.name: ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to request a 1-hour prompt cache TTL instead of the default 5 minutes. Intended for API key, [Bedrock](/en/amazon-bedrock), [Vertex](/en/google-vertex-ai), and [Foundry](/en/microsoft-foundry) users. Subscription users receive 1-hour TTL automatically. 1-hour cache writes are billed at a higher rate

envVars.name: ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H_BEDROCK
envVars.purpose: Deprecated. Use `ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H` instead

envVars.name: ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH
envVars.purpose: Controls [MCP tool search](/en/mcp#scale-with-mcp-tool-search). Unset: all MCP tools deferred by default, but loaded upfront on Vertex AI or when `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` points to a non-first-party host. Values: `true` (always defer including proxies and Vertex AI), `auto` (threshold mode: load upfront if tools fit within 10% of context), `auto:N` (custom threshold, e.g., `auto:5` for 5%), `false` (load all upfront)

envVars.name: FALLBACK_FOR_ALL_PRIMARY_MODELS
envVars.purpose: Set to any non-empty value to trigger fallback to [`--fallback-model`](/en/cli-reference#cli-flags) after repeated overload errors on any primary model. By default, only Opus models trigger the fallback

envVars.name: FORCE_AUTOUPDATE_PLUGINS
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to force plugin auto-updates even when the main auto-updater is disabled via `DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER`

envVars.name: FORCE_PROMPT_CACHING_5M
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to force the 5-minute prompt cache TTL even when 1-hour TTL would otherwise apply. Overrides `ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H`

envVars.name: HTTP_PROXY
envVars.purpose: Specify HTTP proxy server for network connections

envVars.name: HTTPS_PROXY
envVars.purpose: Specify HTTPS proxy server for network connections

envVars.name: IS_DEMO
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to enable demo mode: hides your email and organization name from the header and `/status` output, and skips onboarding. Useful when streaming or recording a session

envVars.name: MAX_MCP_OUTPUT_TOKENS
envVars.purpose: Maximum number of tokens allowed in MCP tool responses. Claude Code displays a warning when output exceeds 10,000 tokens. Tools that declare [`anthropic/maxResultSizeChars`](/en/mcp#raise-the-limit-for-a-specific-tool) use that character limit for text content instead, but image content from those tools is still subject to this variable (default: 25000)

envVars.name: MAX_STRUCTURED_OUTPUT_RETRIES
envVars.purpose: Number of times to retry when the model's response fails validation against the [`--json-schema`](/en/cli-reference#cli-flags) in non-interactive mode (the `-p` flag). Defaults to 5

envVars.name: MAX_THINKING_TOKENS
envVars.purpose: Override the [extended thinking](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/extended-thinking) token budget. The ceiling is the model's [max output tokens](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview#latest-models-comparison) minus one. Set to `0` to disable thinking entirely. On models with [adaptive reasoning](/en/model-config#adjust-effort-level), the budget is ignored unless adaptive reasoning is disabled via `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ADAPTIVE_THINKING`

envVars.name: MCP_CLIENT_SECRET
envVars.purpose: OAuth client secret for MCP servers that require [pre-configured credentials](/en/mcp#use-pre-configured-oauth-credentials). Avoids the interactive prompt when adding a server with `--client-secret`

envVars.name: MCP_CONNECTION_NONBLOCKING
envVars.purpose: Set to `true` in non-interactive mode (`-p`) to skip the MCP connection wait entirely. Useful for scripted pipelines where MCP tools are not needed. Without this variable, the first query waits up to 5 seconds for `--mcp-config` server connections

envVars.name: MCP_OAUTH_CALLBACK_PORT
envVars.purpose: Fixed port for the OAuth redirect callback, as an alternative to `--callback-port` when adding an MCP server with [pre-configured credentials](/en/mcp#use-pre-configured-oauth-credentials)

envVars.name: MCP_REMOTE_SERVER_CONNECTION_BATCH_SIZE
envVars.purpose: Maximum number of remote MCP servers (HTTP/SSE) to connect in parallel during startup (default: 20)

envVars.name: MCP_SERVER_CONNECTION_BATCH_SIZE
envVars.purpose: Maximum number of local MCP servers (stdio) to connect in parallel during startup (default: 3)

envVars.name: MCP_TIMEOUT
envVars.purpose: Timeout in milliseconds for MCP server startup (default: 30000, or 30 seconds)

envVars.name: MCP_TOOL_TIMEOUT
envVars.purpose: Timeout in milliseconds for MCP tool execution (default: 100000000, about 28 hours)

envVars.name: NO_PROXY
envVars.purpose: List of domains and IPs to which requests will be directly issued, bypassing proxy

envVars.name: OTEL_LOG_RAW_API_BODIES
envVars.purpose: Emit Anthropic Messages API request and response JSON as `api_request_body` / `api_response_body` log events. Set to `1` for inline bodies truncated at 60 KB, or `file:<dir>` to write untruncated bodies to disk and emit a `body_ref` path instead. Disabled by default; bodies include the entire conversation history. See [Monitoring](/en/monitoring-usage#api-request-body-event)

envVars.name: OTEL_LOG_TOOL_CONTENT
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to include tool input and output content in OpenTelemetry span events. Disabled by default to protect sensitive data. See [Monitoring](/en/monitoring-usage)

envVars.name: OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to include tool input arguments, MCP server names, raw error strings on tool failures, and other tool details in OpenTelemetry traces and logs. Disabled by default to protect PII. See [Monitoring](/en/monitoring-usage)

envVars.name: OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS
envVars.purpose: Set to `1` to include user prompt text in OpenTelemetry traces and logs. Disabled by default (prompts are redacted). See [Monitoring](/en/monitoring-usage)

envVars.name: OTEL_METRICS_INCLUDE_ACCOUNT_UUID
envVars.purpose: Set to `false` to exclude account UUID from metrics attributes (default: included). See [Monitoring](/en/monitoring-usage)

envVars.name: OTEL_METRICS_INCLUDE_SESSION_ID
envVars.purpose: Set to `false` to exclude session ID from metrics attributes (default: included). See [Monitoring](/en/monitoring-usage)

envVars.name: OTEL_METRICS_INCLUDE_VERSION
envVars.purpose: Set to `true` to include Claude Code version in metrics attributes (default: excluded). See [Monitoring](/en/monitoring-usage)

envVars.name: SLASH_COMMAND_TOOL_CHAR_BUDGET
envVars.purpose: Override the character budget for skill metadata shown to the [Skill tool](/en/skills#control-who-invokes-a-skill). The budget scales dynamically at 1% of the context window, with a fallback of 8,000 characters. Legacy name kept for backwards compatibility

envVars.name: TASK_MAX_OUTPUT_LENGTH
envVars.purpose: Maximum number of characters in [subagent](/en/sub-agents) output before truncation (default: 32000, maximum: 160000). When truncated, the full output is saved to disk and the path is included in the truncated response

envVars.name: USE_BUILTIN_RIPGREP
envVars.purpose: Set to `0` to use system-installed `rg` instead of `rg` included with Claude Code

envVars.name: VERTEX_REGION_CLAUDE_3_5_HAIKU
envVars.purpose: Override region for Claude 3.5 Haiku when using Vertex AI

envVars.name: VERTEX_REGION_CLAUDE_3_5_SONNET
envVars.purpose: Override region for Claude 3.5 Sonnet when using Vertex AI

envVars.name: VERTEX_REGION_CLAUDE_3_7_SONNET
envVars.purpose: Override region for Claude 3.7 Sonnet when using Vertex AI

envVars.name: VERTEX_REGION_CLAUDE_4_0_OPUS
envVars.purpose: Override region for Claude 4.0 Opus when using Vertex AI

envVars.name: VERTEX_REGION_CLAUDE_4_0_SONNET
envVars.purpose: Override region for Claude 4.0 Sonnet when using Vertex AI

envVars.name: VERTEX_REGION_CLAUDE_4_1_OPUS
envVars.purpose: Override region for Claude 4.1 Opus when using Vertex AI

envVars.name: VERTEX_REGION_CLAUDE_4_5_OPUS
envVars.purpose: Override region for Claude Opus 4.5 when using Vertex AI

envVars.name: VERTEX_REGION_CLAUDE_4_5_SONNET
envVars.purpose: Override region for Claude Sonnet 4.5 when using Vertex AI

envVars.name: VERTEX_REGION_CLAUDE_4_6_OPUS
envVars.purpose: Override region for Claude Opus 4.6 when using Vertex AI

envVars.name: VERTEX_REGION_CLAUDE_4_6_SONNET
envVars.purpose: Override region for Claude Sonnet 4.6 when using Vertex AI

envVars.name: VERTEX_REGION_CLAUDE_4_7_OPUS
envVars.purpose: {/* min-version: 2.1.111 */}Override region for Claude Opus 4.7 when using Vertex AI

envVars.name: VERTEX_REGION_CLAUDE_HAIKU_4_5
envVars.purpose: Override region for Claude Haiku 4.5 when using Vertex AI
